note: Patches other mods make to the same code, the same way, as one of our switches. Exactly one copy may run: while the other mod's patch is active (installed, its mixin listed for this side, its option on), our switch steps aside; otherwise our switch applies and the other mod's mixin is cancelled. See bons.furious.guard.ForeignPatches. Checked against Collections Of Optimizations 4.4 (CurseForge file 9026925, sha1 d1b067885b0827c12b7eb75bc02896d270adaed8) on 2026-10-02.

yields.name: Collections Of Optimizations
yields.why: Both run RenderSystem.limitDisplayFPS just before Window.updateDisplay. Called twice in a row the limiter waits a second full frame interval, so with both on every frame waits twice and a frame-rate cap is halved (vsync off).

yields.name: Collections Of Optimizations
yields.why: Both @Overwrite EventFactory.invokeMethod with the same direct Method.invoke. Mixin keeps the first and logs 'Method overwrite conflict ... Skipping method' for the other; with COO's option off its copy is the original MethodHandle path.

yields.name: Collections Of Optimizations
yields.why: Both @Overwrite EasingType.apply, easeOut, easeInOut and bounce to evaluate GeckoLib's own easing functions with primitive doubles (client only in COO). Mixin keeps one copy of each and logs four overwrite conflicts. COO skips its GeckoLib patches when gbf or geckolib_animation_optimizer is installed.
